## 1. How QareGO works for your store

1. A customer near you opens the QareGO app, finds your store and places an order. They pay in **cash** or by **mobile money**.
2. Your **merchant portal** rings with the new order.
3. You **accept** it and prepare it.
4. You mark it **ready**. QareGO sends a nearby rider to collect it.
5. The rider takes it to the customer and confirms delivery with the customer's 4-digit code.
6. You're paid your share (see [section 6](#6-money-what-you-earn-and-how-youre-paid)).

Customers can also choose **pickup** (they collect from your counter) or **schedule** an order for a later time, if your store allows it.

## 2. Joining QareGO

1. **Apply.** Go to **qarego.com** and tap "List your store", or WhatsApp **050 177 4210**. Tell us your store's name, type and location.
2. **Get your sign-in details.** When QareGO approves your application, you receive an SMS with your username and a temporary password.
3. **Sign in** at **merchant.qarego.com**. You are asked to choose your own password the first time.
4. **Set up your store** (next section) and **submit it for review**.
5. **Go live.** QareGO checks your store. When it's approved you get a notification and customers can see you in the app. If something needs fixing, QareGO tells you what to change.

One vendor account can run **several stores**. Each store is set up and reviewed on its own.

## 3. Setting up your store

Your store needs these before you can submit it:

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| **Store photo** | The first thing customers see. Use a clear, bright photo. |
| **Address and map pin** | Riders use the pin to find you. Put it exactly at your entrance. |
| **Opening hours** | Customers can only order while you're open. |
| **At least 3 items with photos** | Your menu or product list. Laundries need at least 3 items on their price list; photos aren't needed. Gas stations don't need a list (QareGO sets cylinder prices). |
| **Licence** (pharmacies and gas stations only) | Pharmacies: Pharmacy Council licence. Gas stations: NPA LPG retail licence. Upload a clear photo and enter the licence number. |

**Tips**
- **Photos:** you can crop each photo when you upload it, and the portal makes it smaller automatically, so uploads are quick.
- **Prices:** enter the price you want for each item. Your commission is taken from this price (see section 6), so set your prices with that in mind.
- **Options and extras** (sizes, add-ons) can be added to items, with their own prices.
- **Discounts:** you can put an item on offer with a percentage discount. The old price is shown crossed out.
- **Your payout MoMo number:** mobile money payments for your orders are sent to this number. Check it's correct. If none is set, your account phone number is used.

## 4. Handling orders

Keep the merchant portal open on the **Orders** page during opening hours. Turn the sound on: new orders ring until someone looks at them.

| Order status | What you do |
|---|---|
| **New** | Accept it (or reject it if you can't make it). A mobile money order can only be accepted once the customer has paid. |
| **Preparing** | Prepare the order. |
| **Ready** | Mark it ready when it's packed. QareGO sends a rider, or for pickup orders the customer comes to you. |
| **Picked up** | The rider has it. You can follow it to the customer. |
| **Delivered** | Done. Your money is settled (section 6). |

**Pickup orders:** when the customer collects, mark the order **Collected**.

**Scheduled orders:** the order shows the time the customer wants it and the time to **start preparing**. QareGO only sends the rider in time for that slot.

**Busy or closed?** Use **Pause orders** in the portal to stop new orders for a while without changing your opening hours. Mark single items **sold out** when you run out.

## 5. Store types with special steps

**Pharmacies**
- Customers attach **prescription photos** for prescription-only medicines. Check every prescription before you supply. You decide whether to supply each item.
- Riders are not shown the names of medicines, only how many items there are.

**Gas stations**
- **Refill:** a rider collects the customer's empty cylinder and brings it to you. You fill it, and a rider takes it back.
- **Exchange:** you hand a full cylinder to the rider. When the customer's empty cylinder comes back, mark **Empty returned**.
- Cylinder prices are set by QareGO and shown to the customer before they order.

**Laundries**
- A rider **collects** the customer's bag first and brings it to you.
- You **count the items** and enter them from your price list in the portal. If the count costs more than the customer's estimate, the customer must approve the new price before you wash. If they decline, the bag goes back unwashed.
- When it's done, mark it ready and a rider returns it to the customer.
- Laundry orders are **cash only**.

## 6. Money: what you earn and how you're paid

### Your share

You earn the **price of the items** in each order, minus QareGO's commission.

- **Commission** is a percentage of the item price. The default is **15%**; gas stations pay **5%** of the gas price. Your rate is in your partner agreement, and the portal shows the commission on every order.
- The **delivery fee** and the customer's **service fee** are paid by the customer and are not taken from your price.
- In the portal you only see the item price (your sales), never the delivery or service fee.

*Example:* GH₵100 of food at 15% commission → **you get GH₵85**.

### Free period for new stores

QareGO may give a new store a **free period with no commission at all**. The portal shows "No QareGO commission until [date]" on your Transactions page, and each free order is marked **No commission**. When the period ends, the normal commission applies automatically. An order placed during the free period stays free, even if it's delivered later.

### How you're paid

| How the customer pays | How you get your share |
|---|---|
| **Cash, delivery** | The rider pays you **your share in cash** (the item price minus commission) when they collect the order. Nothing more to settle. |
| **Mobile money, delivery or pickup** | Your share is **sent to your payout MoMo number automatically** when the order is delivered or collected. |
| **Cash, pickup** | The customer pays **you** the full amount at your counter. QareGO's share (the commission and the customer's service fee) is then owed to QareGO. |

### Your balance with QareGO

Some amounts are owed to QareGO and are recorded against your store:
- QareGO's share of **cash pickup orders**;
- **cancellation charges** (section 7).

You can see what you owe, and every entry, on the **Transactions** page under **Balance with QareGO**.

- **Pay QareGO:** tap the button there to pay by mobile money or card. It goes off your balance as soon as the payment goes through. You can also pay in cash to QareGO, which records it for you.
- **Debt limit:** if your store owes more than QareGO's limit, **new orders are paused** until you pay. Customers see your store as temporarily closed. The Kitchen page shows a red banner with the amount, and orders start again the moment you're back under the limit.

### Your records

The **Transactions** page shows every order with its date, customer, payment method, item price (gross), your share (net) and payout status:

- **Paid**: you've been paid your share.
- **Sending**: a mobile money payment is on its way.
- **Pending**: the order isn't finished yet.
- **Payout failed**: the mobile money payment didn't go through. QareGO retries it. Check your payout number is right.

## 7. Cancellations

- **Customers** can cancel a store order only until you accept it. If they paid by mobile money, they're refunded automatically.
- **You** can reject a new order, or cancel one you can't complete (for example, an item is out). Do it as early as possible.
- **If a rider has already set off** when you cancel, the rider is paid for their trip and **the charge is added to your balance**: **half** the delivery fee once a rider has accepted, the **full** delivery fee once they've reached your store or are carrying the order.
- If **QareGO** cancels an order, QareGO pays any rider charge, not you.

## 8. Your staff

- Add **cook accounts** for your kitchen staff under **Cooks**. Each cook account is locked to one store and can handle its orders, but can't see your money or other stores.
- Keep your own sign-in private. Don't share it with staff; give them cook accounts instead.

## 9. Good practice

- **Accept orders quickly.** The customer is waiting, and a quick reply brings them back.
- **Keep your menu true:** prices, photos, sold-out items and opening hours.
- **Pack well.** Seal food and drinks; keep hot and cold items apart.
- **Check the code, not the person.** Never hand over an order without the rider being there for it. The customer's code is for the rider; don't ask customers for it.
- **Protect customer details.** Use a customer's name and phone only for their order.
